## 0.1 Redraft Notes — Unified Edges

This V2 redraft keeps the V1 Payment Gateway candidate-card semantics and replaces the edge layer with the full unified canonical edge taxonomy supplied for cross-domain clean markdowns. The file now follows the deterministic V8-style pattern used in the Amazon and Flipkart reference markdowns: canonical uppercase edge types, legacy alias normalization, inverse edge metadata, `materialize_inverse` flags, edge-family classification, and business-flow-binding templates without instantiating tenant/account cards.

Edge count after unification: **2500** candidate edges, including **1069** materialized inverse edges.

## 0. Parser Instructions

This document is intended to be parsed deterministically. It is not a prose-only summary. Every `candidate_card`, `candidate_edge`, `source_evidence`, `review_item`, SQL reference block, and edge taxonomy block is machine-readable while preserving the generic payment-gateway boundary.

Critical parser rules:

- Create only reusable payment-gateway semantic cards from this document.
- Do not create tenant, group, platform account, account-data-binding, business-scope-set, or business-flow-binding cards unless a separate tenant-specific source explicitly supplies those IDs and bindings.
- Treat `merchant_id`, `seller_id`, `store_id`, `group_id`, `group_level_id`, `bank_account`, `beneficiary_account`, and similar fields as columns or runtime filter candidates, not account cards.
- `rbl_oms_payin` is bank-side evidence. It may support gateway-to-bank reconciliation profiles, but it is not a payment gateway platform table and must not create a bank-account card.
- Normalize all legacy edge aliases into canonical uppercase edge types before graph ingestion.
- Materialize inverse graph edges only when `materialize_inverse: true`; otherwise use reverse graph indexes.
- Business Flow Binding edges in this generic document are template-only. Instantiate them only from tenant/group/platform-account/account-data-binding evidence.
- Keep gateway payin, payout, settlement, refund, fee, tax, chargeback, BNPL, app-store, and bank-side evidence semantics distinct.
- Prefer decimal/mapped amount columns over raw text amount fields when both exist.
- Preserve source sign conventions. Use `ABS()` only when a metric implementation explicitly calls for presentational refund/fee magnitude.
- Normalize legacy `_temp_old` fields as migration artifacts and keep them as caveats unless explicitly needed.

## 3. Canonical Card Field Contract

The following table is intentionally broad. It covers the canonical type-specific fields from the design document. In this gold standard, business hierarchy card types other than `platform` and `platform_context` are documented for field compatibility but are not emitted as candidate cards without tenant-specific evidence.

| card_type | canonical fields to populate | emission policy in this document |
|---|---|---|
| `tenant` | `tenant_name, tenant_code, description, active, status, source_documents` | emit only with tenant/account source evidence |
| `group` | `tenant_id, group_name, group_code, group_type, business_meaning, country_or_region, default_currency, active, status, source_documents` | emit only with tenant/account source evidence |
| `platform` | `platform_name, platform_type, description, active, status, source_documents, aliases, supported_contexts` | emit reusable platform/context cards |
| `platform_context` | `platform_id, context_name, context_type, source_context_code, country, region, currency, timezone, active, status, source_documents` | emit reusable platform/context cards |
| `platform_account` | `tenant_id, group_id, platform_id, platform_context_id, account_name, account_type, source_account_identifier, active, status, source_documents` | emit only with tenant/account source evidence |
| `account_data_binding` | `platform_account_id, table_id, scope_keys, scope_keys[].business_key, scope_keys[].column, scope_keys[].operator, scope_keys[].value, scope_keys[].data_type, notes, active, status, source_documents` | emit only with tenant/account source evidence |

| `business_flow_binding` | `tenant_id, group_id, binding_name, binding_type, business_scope_set_id, business_process_ids, reconciliation_profile_ids, money_flow_paths, participating_accounts, conditions, evidence_table_ids, account_data_binding_ids, relationship_ids, confidence, notes, active, status, source_documents` | emit only with tenant/account source evidence |

## 4.1 Unified Edge Taxonomy Registry — Parser Contract

The edge layer below is the deterministic ingestion contract for this payment gateway clean markdown. Candidate edges use canonical uppercase edge types, explicit source/target card IDs, inverse edge metadata, and materialization flags. Legacy aliases are accepted only as parser helpers and must be canonicalized before graph ingestion.

```yaml
edge_materialization_policy:
  source_of_truth: Store one canonical directed edge with inverse metadata.
  required_fields:
  - edge_type
  - source_card_id
  - target_card_id
  - inverse_edge_type
  - materialize_inverse
  materialize_inverse_when:
  - structural containment
  - ownership
  - membership
  - parent_child navigation is common from both sides
  do_not_materialize_inverse_by_default_when:
  - usage edge
  - provenance edge
  - query dependency edge
  - formula/table/column usage edge
  - applicability edge
  always_materialized_pairs:
    HAS_PLATFORM_CONTEXT: BELONGS_TO_PLATFORM
    HAS_COLUMN: BELONGS_TO_TABLE
    HAS_VALUE_PROFILE: PROFILES_COLUMN_or_PROFILES_TABLE
    HAS_IMPLEMENTATION: IMPLEMENTS_METRIC
    HAS_BUSINESS_PROCESS: BELONGS_TO_DOMAIN
    HAS_WORKFLOW_STEP: BELONGS_TO_PROCESS
    HAS_STATE_TRANSITION: BELONGS_TO_PROCESS
    HAS_PROCESS_VARIANT: EXTENDS_PROCESS
    HAS_RECONCILIATION_PROFILE: SUPPORTS_PROCESS
    HAS_RECONCILIATION_SIDE: BELONGS_TO_RECONCILIATION_PROFILE
    USES_MATCHING_LOGIC: SUPPORTS_RECONCILIATION_PROFILE
    HAS_VALIDATION_TEST_for_rule: ENFORCES_RULE
  usually_single_direction:
  - SOURCED_FROM_PLATFORM
  - SOURCED_FROM_PLATFORM_CONTEXT
  - USES_TABLE
  - USES_COLUMN
  - USES_FORMULA_TEMPLATE
  - DEPENDS_ON_METRIC
  - PRODUCES_METRIC
  - USES_RECONCILIATION_PROFILE
  - USES_RELATIONSHIP
  - REQUIRES_RULE
  - USES_OUTPUT_CONTRACT
  - INCLUDES_RULE
  - INCLUDES_VALIDATION_TEST
  - APPLIES_TO_QUERY_PATTERN
  - APPLIES_TO_PLATFORM
  - APPLIES_TO_PLATFORM_CONTEXT
  - APPLIES_TO_BUSINESS_FLOW_BINDING
```

```yaml
business_flow_binding_template_policy:
  generic_payment_gateway_document_rule: Do not emit business_flow_binding, platform_account, account_data_binding, tenant, group, or business_scope_set
    cards from this generic Payment Gateway KB.
  instantiate_business_flow_binding_only_when:
  - tenant_id is known
  - group_id is known
  - platform_account IDs are known
  - account_data_binding cards exist for gateway and bank tables
  - the flow is recurring and role-based
  payment_gateway_to_bank_template:
    template_id: business_flow_binding.<tenant_group>.<gateway>_to_<bank>
    required_account_roles:
    - settlement_source_account
    - bank_destination_account
    canonical_edges_to_emit_when_instantiated:
    - USES_SETTLEMENT_SOURCE_ACCOUNT
    - USES_BANK_DESTINATION_ACCOUNT
    - USES_ACCOUNT_DATA_BINDING
    - USES_TABLE
    - USES_RELATIONSHIP
    - SUPPORTS_PROCESS
    - SUPPORTS_RECONCILIATION_PROFILE
    - USES_QUERY_PATTERN
    - USES_EXECUTION_CONSTRAINT_SET
    supported_process: business_process.pg.gateway_settlement_cycle
    supported_reconciliation_profile: reconciliation_profile.pg.gateway_payout_to_bank_credit
    do_not_store_in_business_flow_binding:
    - generic matching logic
    - SQL plans
    - account filter values outside AccountDataBinding
    - reconciliation tolerances
  forbidden_domain_specific_binding_edges_or_cards:
  - PAYMENT_ROUTE_BINDING
  - GATEWAY_BANK_ROUTE_BINDING
  - BANK_ROUTE_BINDING
  - ERP_BANK_ROUTE_BINDING
  - LOGISTICS_ROUTE_BINDING
```

```yaml
legacy_edge_alias_normalization:
  column_belongs_to_table:
    canonical_edge_type: BELONGS_TO_TABLE

    canonical_edge_type: PROFILES_COLUMN

  implementation_uses_column:

    canonical_edge_type: IMPLEMENTS_METRIC
  metric_depends_on_metric:
    canonical_edge_type: DEPENDS_ON_METRIC

    canonical_edge_type: USES_TABLE
  query_targets_card:
    canonical_edge_type: TARGETS_CARD

      metric: PRODUCES_METRIC
      reconciliation_profile: USES_RECONCILIATION_PROFILE
      rule: REQUIRES_RULE
      output_contract: USES_OUTPUT_CONTRACT
      relationship: USES_RELATIONSHIP
  process_uses_table:
    canonical_edge_type: USES_TABLE
    edge_class: parser_helper
  step_in_process:
    canonical_edge_type: BELONGS_TO_PROCESS
  transition_in_process:
    canonical_edge_type: BELONGS_TO_PROCESS

    canonical_edge_type: HAS_RECONCILIATION_SIDE
    edge_properties:
      side_role: actual

  profile_uses_matching_logic:
    canonical_edge_type: USES_MATCHING_LOGIC
  profile_has_mismatch_category:
    canonical_edge_type: HAS_MISMATCH_CATEGORY
  side_uses_table:
    canonical_edge_type: USES_TABLE
    edge_class: parser_helper
  side_uses_key_column:
    canonical_edge_type: USES_COLUMN
    edge_class: parser_helper
    edge_properties:
      column_role: key
  side_uses_amount_column:
    canonical_edge_type: USES_COLUMN
    edge_class: parser_helper
    edge_properties:
      column_role: amount
  validation_enforces_constraint:
    canonical_edge_type: INCLUDES_VALIDATION_TEST
    parser_note: Reverse old direction during canonicalization.
  rule_enforced_by_constraint:
    canonical_edge_type: INCLUDES_RULE
    parser_note: Reverse old direction during canonicalization.
```

```yaml
    - '`trace_id` is the bank-side reference for wire reconciliation.'
    - '`payment_metadata_1` to `payment_metadata_33` are merchant-customized — content varies by merchant.'
    - '`_temp_old` suffixed columns are migration artifacts — do not use.'
    - '`connected_account_id` is relevant for Stripe Connect/marketplace setups.'
    - Some financial amount fields are stored as Text; prefer mapped Decimal columns when available or cast explicitly.
```

```yaml
    - '`presentment_currency` ≠ `currency` when customers pay in a different currency (DCC — Dynamic Currency Conversion).'
    - '`checkout` field is the Shopify checkout ID — legacy field, now mapped to `order_id`.'
    - '`recon_transaction_type` is a platform-derived classification for reconciliation use.'
```

```yaml

  card_id: relationship.razorpay.payin_payout.utr

  confidence: inferred
  source_documents:
  - Payment Gateway KB.docx
  evidence_refs:
  - evidence.pg.razorpay
  - evidence.pg.paytm
  - evidence.pg.phonepe
  - evidence.pg.stripe
  - evidence.pg.rbl_bank
  fields:
    source_table: table.zs_observe.razorpay_payin
    target_table: table.zs_observe.razorpay_payout
    relationship_type: reconciliation_relation
    join_keys:
    - source_column: settlement_utr or utr
      target_column: utr
    cardinality: many_to_many_review
    join_type_recommendation: left_join_or_full_outer_for_reconciliation
    business_use: Match Razorpay payin settlement/payout references to payout UTRs; cast payout.utr if stored numeric.

    safe_for_reconciliation: true
```

```yaml
    business_use: Stripe charge-level report joins to balance transaction settlement rows through id = charge_id.
    safe_for_metrics: false
    safe_for_reconciliation: true
    aggregation_risk: Pre-aggregate settlement/bank evidence by reconciliation unit before comparing amounts.
    caveats:
    - Tenant/group applicability belongs to Business Flow Binding, not Relationship cards.
```

```yaml
candidate_card:
  card_type: metric_implementation
  card_id: metric_implementation.pg.generic.gross_payment_volume.payin
  canonical_id: metric_implementation.pg.generic.gross_payment_volume.payin

  source_documents:

  - evidence.pg.stripe
  fields:
    metric_id: metric.gross_payment_volume
    implementation_name: Generic payin GPV
    applicability:
      scope_level: table_or_platform_type
      platform_types:
      - payment_gateway
      - bnpl_gateway
      - app_store_platform
      notes:
      - Runtime account filters come from Account Data Binding.
    base_tables: []
    required_columns: []
    semantic_filters:
    - txn_type/status indicates successful sale
    - is_active = true when available
    formula_description: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type/txn_type indicates SALE or charge THEN gross amount ELSE 0 END)
    formula_sql: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type/txn_type indicates SALE or charge THEN gross amount ELSE 0 END)
    dependent_metrics: []
    formula_template_id: null
    allowed_dimensions:
    - date
    - currency
    - payment_mode
    - status
    - gateway
    - settlement_id
    - payout_id
    allowed_grains:
    - transaction
    - batch
    - day
    - month
    - currency
    - payment_mode
```

```yaml
    formula_sql_pattern: COUNT(CASE WHEN status IN success_values THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)
    allowed_metric_types:
    - amount
    - rate
    - ratio
    - variance
    - duration
    required_date_logic: Use recommended date basis from the table/metric implementation.
    denominator_handling: Use NULLIF denominator, 0.
    null_handling: Preserve nulls unless source rule says otherwise.
    output_unit_logic: Currency for amounts, percentage for rates, days for duration.
```

```yaml
  status: active

  evidence_refs:
```

```yaml
  fields:
    logic_name: Gateway to bank reference, amount, date
    description: Gateway to bank reference, amount, date
    reconciliation_profile_id: reconciliation_profile.pg.gateway_payout_to_bank_credit
    matching_strategy: hybrid
    primary_match_keys:
    - UTR/trace/RRN/ARN/payout/deposit/reference exact match
    secondary_match_keys:
    - amount + currency + date window
    - narration reference extraction
    fallback_match_strategy: amount/date fallback after reference extraction
    expected_alignment_type: one_to_one_or_many_to_one
    amount_tolerance: 0.01 or currency minor unit
    time_tolerance: T+0 to T+n; provider-specific
    match_confidence_rules:
    - exact reference + amount = high
    - amount/date only = medium/low
    - missing reference = review_required
    unmatched_handling: Classify using mismatch categories and output diagnostics.
    notes:
    - Do not embed tenant account filters in matching logic.
```

```yaml
candidate_card:
  card_type: query_pattern
  card_id: query_pattern.pg.net_settlement_by_batch
  canonical_id: query_pattern.pg.net_settlement_by_batch
  name: Net settlement by batch
  description: SUM(net/settled amount) grouped by settlement/payout batch
  status: active
  confidence: inferred
  source_documents:
  - Payment Gateway KB.docx
  evidence_refs:
  - evidence.pg.razorpay
  - evidence.pg.cashfree
  fields:
    pattern_name: Net settlement by batch
    description: SUM(net/settled amount) grouped by settlement/payout batch
    pattern_type: analytical
    supported_intents:
    - settlement by batch
    - net settled by payout
    - payout summary
    applicability_scope:
      scope_level: platform_type
      platform_types:
      - payment_gateway
      - bnpl_gateway
      - app_store_platform
      - banking_when_reconciliation
    required_tables:
    - contextual_payment_gateway_tables
    optional_tables:
    - table.zs_observe.rbl_oms_payin for bank reconciliation
    required_metrics:
    - metric.net_settlement_amount
    allowed_dimensions:
    - settlement_id
    - payout_id
    - deposit_id
    - automatic_payout_id
    - settlement_date
    - currency
    allowed_grains:
    - transaction
    - settlement_batch
    - payout_batch
    - day
    - month
    - currency
    - payment_mode
    - status
    recommended_date_columns:
    - settlement_date
    - txn_date
    - created_date
    - payout_date
    - posted_date
    semantic_filters:
    - is_active = true where available
    - is_duplicated = false where available
    - exclude failed/canceled where metric requires settled success
    join_constraints:
    - Use relationship cards; pre-aggregate before joins.
    aggregation_rules:
    - Do not join raw many-side rows and sum both sides; aggregate to reconciliation unit first.
    query_shape: SUM(net/settled amount) grouped by settlement/payout batch
    linked_rules:
    - rule.pg.active_filter
    - rule.pg.duplicate_filter
    - rule.pg.text_amount_cast
    validation_tests:
    - validation_test.pg.active_filter_present
    - validation_test.pg.amount_columns_decimal_or_cast
    output_contract_id: output_contract.pg.standard_metric_or_reconciliation
```

## 7. Review Items

```yaml
review_item:
  id: review.pg.business_flow_binding_template_only
  issue: Gateway-to-bank, BNPL-to-bank, and app-store-to-bank flow edges are template-only in this generic KB. Do not instantiate BusinessFlowBinding, PlatformAccount, or AccountDataBinding edges until tenant/group/account evidence is supplied.
  severity: high
  recommended_action: Create tenant-scoped Business Flow Binding cards only from account binding documents; keep generic reconciliation profiles reusable.
  status: open
```
```yaml
review_item:
  id: review.pg.missing_tables
  issue: The Payment Gateway KB lists multiple missing tables not found in zs_observe; do not emit active table cards for those names unless later source evidence
    confirms them.
  severity: medium
  recommended_action: Resolve during human review or with tenant-specific/account-specific binding documents.
  status: open
```
```yaml
review_item:
  id: review.pg.rbl_oms_payin_boundary
  issue: Confirm whether rbl_oms_payin should be part of the payment-gateway gold standard as bank-side evidence or moved to banking KB.
  severity: medium
  recommended_action: Resolve during human review or with tenant-specific/account-specific binding documents.
  status: open
```
```yaml
review_item:
  id: review.pg.text_amount_columns
  issue: Several sources store amount/fee/net fields as Text; confirm casting and preferred Decimal alternates per deployment.
  severity: high
  recommended_action: Resolve during human review or with tenant-specific/account-specific binding documents.
  status: open
```
```yaml
review_item:
  id: review.pg.status_values
  issue: Status value profiles vary by gateway and should be profiled from live data before final hardcoded enum validation.
  severity: medium
  recommended_action: Resolve during human review or with tenant-specific/account-specific binding documents.
  status: open
```
```yaml
review_item:
  id: review.pg.tenant_bindings
  issue: No tenant/group/account binding evidence is present in Payment Gateway KB; account data binding must be supplied separately.
  severity: high
  recommended_action: Resolve during human review or with tenant-specific/account-specific binding documents.
  status: open
```

## 9. SQL Pattern Registry — Parser Hints

```yaml
sql_pattern:
  id: sql.pg.generic_settlement_summary
  purpose: generic settlement summary
  sql_shape: SELECT settlement_id, settlement_date, currency, SUM(gross_amount) gross, SUM(fee_amount) fees, SUM(tax_amount) taxes, SUM(net_amount) net FROM <gateway_settlement_cte>
    WHERE active_filters GROUP BY 1,2,3;
  notes:
  - Pseudo-SQL only; orchestrator owns final SQL generation and dialect repair.
```
```yaml
sql_pattern:
  id: sql.pg.payment_mode_breakdown
  purpose: payment mode breakdown
  sql_shape: SELECT payment_mode, COUNT(*) transactions, SUM(amount) gross_volume FROM <payin_table> WHERE sale_success_filters GROUP BY payment_mode;
  notes:
  - Pseudo-SQL only; orchestrator owns final SQL generation and dialect repair.
```
```yaml
sql_pattern:
  id: sql.pg.refund_original_linkage
  purpose: refund original linkage
  sql_shape: SELECT r.*, p.transaction_id original_transaction_id FROM <payin_table> r LEFT JOIN <payin_table> p ON r.original_reference = p.transaction_id WHERE
    r.refund_filter;
  notes:
  - Pseudo-SQL only; orchestrator owns final SQL generation and dialect repair.
```
```yaml
sql_pattern:
  id: sql.pg.gateway_to_bank_recon
  purpose: gateway to bank recon
  sql_shape: WITH expected AS (<gateway settlement/payout aggregation>), actual AS (<bank credit aggregation with reference extraction>) SELECT ... FULL OUTER JOIN
    ... ON reference OR amount/date fallback;
  notes:
  - Pseudo-SQL only; orchestrator owns final SQL generation and dialect repair.
```
```yaml
sql_pattern:
  id: sql.pg.failed_payouts
  purpose: failed payouts
  sql_shape: SELECT status, failure_reason, COUNT(*) count, SUM(amount) total_amount FROM <payout_table> WHERE active_filters GROUP BY 1,2;
```
